newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: BP/Texaco Nerefco cat cracker back in operation.
newsitem.headline: BP/Texaco Nerefco cat cracker back in operation.

text.p: The 55,000 barrel a day catalytic cracker at Nerefco's Europoort refinery which was shut on Friday was back in operation this morning, a spokeswoman at the BP /Texaco joint venture said on Monday.
"It is back. It's operating normally," she said.
The cracker at the 200,000 bpd refinery, one of two refineries Nerefco operates in Rotterdam, was shut down on Friday due to technical problems.
The shutdown exacerbated the shortage of gasoline in the European market.

A cracker at Shell's Pernis site in Rotterdam is expected to remain out of operation for three months, a month longer than anticipated, cutting gasoline output at the refinery by 100,000 tonnes per month (28,000 bpd).
